purpose: Unblock W03 source selection without conflating Ireland reference terrain and fictional world geometry

selection_policy.primary: Publicly accessible DEM with explicit redistribution/derivative-game-use rights, measured resolution, CRS, vertical datum, provenance, checksums
selection_policy.fallback: Procedural provisional macro-relief with uncertainty explicitly recorded; no invented native measurements claimed
selection_policy.forbidden: Google Earth imagery/3D extraction into game geometry or textures without separate explicit rights

candidates.note: Copernicus DEM product terms and download entitlement must be checked for the exact product; website alone is not license proof
Portal is an aggregator; each underlying dataset requires separate licensing and access checks

candidates.role: offshore bathymetry and coastal context only
candidates.note: Do not treat bathymetry as high-resolution terrestrial cliff DEM
Not an elevation raster; avoid merging ODbL geometry into unreviewed proprietary game database
No scraping, imagery extraction, 3D mesh extraction or use as game texture without specific permission

art_direction.cliff: Individual sculpted rock masses, joints, fissures and overhangs must follow approved cliff CG, not coarse DEM
art_direction.gentle_terrain: DEM-informed heightfield permitted after geodata provenance review
art_direction.interfaces: Keep official XYZ, sea-level transform and region/cliff seams unresolved until independent QA
